en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an old European town square with arcaded buildings and several people walking in the open plaza. The printed caption at the top right identifies the view as Piazza del Duomo and Via S. Maria. At the bottom there is a handwritten Italian message dated 14 settembre 1901, along with the photographer's imprint. The architecture is typical of a historic Northern Italian city, with multi‑story stucco buildings, shuttered windows, and porticoes.
